0022600209.text: The San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) are on the road at the Phoenix Suns (3-5, 12th in the West) for the Spurs' 11th game of the season, and they come in on an eight-game winning streak with a 4-0 road record. Phoenix has won its last two games and sits 3rd in the Pacific, 4 games back, but Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) are out, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 101-100 Spurs win in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
